62302.name: Overlord Drive · First Strike
62302.SpecificEffects:
ST movement type changes to Levitating, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
Before initiating combat with an active attack, if the target is on the movement path, guaranteed to Dodge when retaliated against, up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
When initiating combat for the first time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>. ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
